translations.idiomatic: Xiazheng took advantage of the interval to seize Hezhou. Shao advanced, broke Henuomucang city, passed through Lougu Mountain, and entered Taozhou territory; the road was narrow and steep, so they abandoned their horses and went on foot, sometimes covering only six or seven li a day.

sentences.zh: 瞎征留其黨守河州，自將尾官軍，韶力戰破走之，河州復平。

translations.literal: Xiazheng left his followers to hold Hezhou and personally led troops to tail the imperial army; Shao fought hard, broke them, and drove them off, and Hezhou was pacified again.
translations.idiomatic: Xiazheng left his followers to hold Hezhou and personally tailed the imperial army; Shao fought hard, broke them, and drove them off, and Hezhou was pacified again.

sentences.zh: 連拔宕、岷二州，疊、洮羌酋皆以城附。

translations.literal: He took Dang and Min prefectures in succession; the chieftains of Die and Tao all submitted their cities.
translations.idiomatic: He took Dang and Min prefectures in succession; the chieftains of Die and Tao all submitted their cities.

sentences.zh: 軍行五十有四日，涉千八百里，得州五，斬首數千級，獲牛、羊、馬以萬計。

translations.literal: The army marched fifty-four days, covered one thousand eight hundred li, gained five prefectures, beheaded several thousand, and captured cattle, sheep, and horses by the tens of thousands.
translations.idiomatic: The army marched fifty-four days, covered eighteen hundred li, gained five prefectures, beheaded several thousand, and captured cattle, sheep, and horses by the tens of thousands.

sentences.zh: 進左諫議大夫、端明殿學士。

translations.literal: He was promoted to Left Remonstrance Grand Master and academician of the Hall of Duanming.
translations.idiomatic: He was promoted to Left Remonstrance Grand Master and academician of the Hall of Duanming.

sentences.zh: 七年，入朝，又加資政殿學士，賜第崇仁坊。

translations.literal: In the seventh year he entered court and was further made Academic Bachelor of the Hall of Zizheng, and granted a residence in Chongren Ward.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh year he entered court, was further made Academic Bachelor of the Hall of Zizheng, and granted a residence in Chongren Ward.

sentences.zh: 還至興平，聞景思立敗於踏白城，賊圍河州，日夜馳至熙。

translations.literal: Returning to Xingping, he heard that Jing Sil had been defeated at Tabai city and the enemy was besieging Hezhou; he raced day and night to Xi.
translations.idiomatic: Returning to Xingping, he heard that Jing Sil had been defeated at Tabai city and the enemy was besieging Hezhou; he raced day and night to Xi.

sentences.zh: 熙方城守，命撤之。

translations.literal: Xi was just then under siege; he ordered the siege lifted.
translations.idiomatic: Xi was just then under siege; he ordered the siege lifted.

sentences.zh: 選兵得二萬。

translations.literal: Selecting troops, he mustered twenty thousand.
translations.idiomatic: Selecting troops, he mustered twenty thousand.

sentences.zh: 議所向，諸將欲趨河州。

translations.literal: When they debated where to go, the generals wished to hurry to Hezhou.
translations.idiomatic: When they debated where to go, the generals wished to hurry to Hezhou.

sentences.zh: 韶曰：「賊所以圍城者，恃有外援也。

translations.literal: Shao said: "The reason the enemy besieges the city is that they rely on outside support."
translations.idiomatic: Shao said, "The reason the enemy besieges the city is that they rely on outside support."

sentences.zh: 今知救至，必設伏待我，且新勝氣銳，未可與爭。

translations.literal: Now that they know relief is coming, they will surely set an ambush for us; and fresh from victory their spirit is sharp—we cannot fight them yet.
translations.idiomatic: Now that they know relief is coming, they will surely set an ambush; fresh from victory their spirit is sharp—we cannot fight them yet.

sentences.zh: 當出其不意，以攻其所恃，此所謂『批亢搗虛，形格勢禁，則自為解』者也。

translations.literal: We should strike where they do not expect, attack what they rely on—this is what is called 'strike the vital point and raid the empty place; check their form and restrain their momentum, and they will release of themselves.'
translations.idiomatic: We should strike where they do not expect and attack what they rely on—this is what is called 'strike the vital point and raid the empty place; check their form and restrain their momentum, and they will release of themselves.'

sentences.zh: 」乃直扣定羌城，破結河族，斷夏國通路，進臨寧河，分命偏將入南山。

translations.literal: Thereupon he pressed straight on Dingqiang city, broke the Jiehe tribe, cut the Western Xia's route of passage, advanced to Ninghe, and dispatched subordinate generals into the southern mountains.
translations.idiomatic: Thereupon he pressed straight on Dingqiang city, broke the Jiehe tribe, cut the Tangut route of passage, advanced to Ninghe, and dispatched subordinate generals into the southern mountains.

sentences.zh: 瞎征知援絕，拔柵去。

translations.literal: Xiazheng, knowing relief was cut off, pulled up his stockades and left.
translations.idiomatic: Xiazheng, knowing relief was cut off, pulled up his stockades and left.

sentences.zh: 初，思立之覆師也，羌勢復熾，朝廷議棄熙河，帝為之旰食，數下詔戒韶持重勿出。

translations.literal: At first, when Sil's army was destroyed, Qiang power flared again; the court debated abandoning Xihe; the emperor lost his appetite over it and repeatedly issued edicts warning Shao to hold steady and not sally forth.
translations.idiomatic: At first, when Sil's army was destroyed, Qiang power flared again; the court debated abandoning Xihe; the emperor lost his appetite over it and repeatedly issued edicts warning Shao to hold steady and not sally forth.

sentences.zh: 及是，帝大喜。

translations.literal: At this the emperor was greatly pleased.
translations.idiomatic: At this the emperor was greatly pleased.

sentences.zh: 韶還熙州，以兵循西山繞出踏白後，焚八千帳，瞎征窮蹙丐降，俘以獻。

translations.literal: Shao returned to Xizhou, led troops along the western mountains to circle behind Tabai, burned eight thousand tents, Xiazheng in desperate straits begged to submit, and was captured and presented.
translations.idiomatic: Shao returned to Xizhou, led troops along the western mountains to circle behind Tabai, burned eight thousand tents, Xiazheng in desperate straits begged to submit, and was captured and presented.

sentences.zh: 拜韶觀文殿學士、禮部侍郎。

translations.literal: Shao was appointed Academic Bachelor of the Hall of Guanwen and Vice Minister of Rites.
translations.idiomatic: Shao was appointed Academic Bachelor of the Hall of Guanwen and Vice Minister of Rites.

sentences.zh: 資政、觀文學士，非嘗執政而除者，皆自韶始。

translations.literal: Academic bachelors of the Zizheng and Guanwen halls who had not previously held chief ministerial office—all began with Shao.
translations.idiomatic: Academic bachelors of the Zizheng and Guanwen halls who had not previously held chief ministerial office—all began with Shao.

sentences.zh: 官其兄弟及兩子，前後賜絹八千匹。

translations.literal: His brothers and two sons were given office; in all he was granted eight thousand bolts of silk.
translations.idiomatic: His brothers and two sons were given office; in all he was granted eight thousand bolts of silk.

sentences.zh: 未幾，召為樞密副使。

translations.literal: Before long he was summoned as Vice Commissioner of the Bureau of Military Affairs.
translations.idiomatic: Before long he was summoned as Vice Commissioner of the Bureau of Military Affairs.

sentences.zh: 熙河雖名一路，而實無租入，軍食皆仰給他道。

translations.literal: Although Xihe was called a circuit, in fact it had no rent income; army provisions all depended on other circuits.
translations.idiomatic: Although Xihe was called a circuit, in fact it had no rent income; army provisions all depended on other circuits.

sentences.zh: 轉運判官馬瑊捃官吏細故，韶欲罷瑊，王安石右瑊，韶始沮，於是與安石異。

translations.literal: Transportation judicial officer Ma Jian collected petty offenses of officials; Shao wished to remove Jian, but Wang Anshi sided with Jian; Shao grew discouraged, and thus differed from Anshi.
translations.idiomatic: Transportation judicial officer Ma Jian collected petty offenses of officials; Shao wished to remove Jian, but Wang Anshi sided with Jian; Shao grew discouraged and thus differed from Anshi.

sentences.zh: 數以母老乞歸，帝語安石勉留之。

translations.literal: Repeatedly citing his mother's age, he begged to return home; the emperor told Anshi to urge him to stay.
translations.idiomatic: Repeatedly citing his mother's age, he begged to return home; the emperor told Anshi to urge him to stay.

sentences.zh: 安南之役，韶言：「決里、廣源之建，臣以為貪虛名而忘實禍，執政乃疑臣為刺譏。

translations.literal: During the Annam campaign, Shao said: "The establishment of Jueli and Guangyuan—I held it greed for empty fame while forgetting real disaster; the chief ministers then suspected me of sarcasm."
translations.idiomatic: During the Annam campaign, Shao said, "The establishment of Jueli and Guangyuan—I held it greed for empty fame while forgetting real disaster; the chief ministers then suspected me of sarcasm."

sentences.zh: 方舉事之初，臣力爭極論，欲寬民力而省財用，但同列莫肯聽，至以熙河事折臣。

translations.literal: At the very start of the campaign I argued strenuously, wishing to ease the people's burden and save state funds, but my colleagues would not listen, even using the Xihe affair to refute me.
translations.idiomatic: At the very start of the campaign I argued strenuously, wishing to ease the people's burden and save state funds, but my colleagues would not listen, even using the Xihe affair to refute me.

sentences.zh: 臣本意不費朝廷而可以至伊吾盧甘，初不欲令熙河作路，河、岷作州也。

translations.literal: My original intent was to reach Yiwu and Lugan without costing the court, and I did not at first wish to make Xihe a circuit or He and Min prefectures.
translations.idiomatic: My original intent was to reach Yiwu and Lugan without costing the court, and I did not at first wish to make Xihe a circuit or He and Min prefectures.

sentences.zh: 今與眾異論，儻不求退，必致不容。

translations.literal: Now that my views differ from the rest, if I do not seek retirement I will surely not be tolerated.
translations.idiomatic: Now that my views differ from the rest, if I do not seek retirement I will surely not be tolerated.

sentences.zh: 」韶本鑿空開邊，驟躋政地，乃以勤兵費財歸曲朝廷，帝由是不悅，以故罷職知洪州，又坐謝表怨慢，落職知鄂州。

translations.literal: Shao had originally opened the frontier from nothing and suddenly risen to power; now he blamed the court for exhausting troops and wasting funds. The emperor was displeased and removed him as prefect of Hongzhou; he was again demoted for resentment and disrespect in his letter of thanks and made prefect of Ezhou.
translations.idiomatic: Shao had originally opened the frontier from nothing and suddenly risen to power; now he blamed the court for exhausting troops and wasting funds. The emperor was displeased and removed him as prefect of Hongzhou; he was again demoted for resentment and disrespect in his letter of thanks and made prefect of Ezhou.

sentences.zh: 元豐二年，還其職，復知洪州。

translations.literal: In the second year of Yuanfeng his former rank was restored and he again served as prefect of Hongzhou.
translations.idiomatic: In the second year of Yuanfeng his former rank was restored and he again served as prefect of Hongzhou.

sentences.zh: 四年，病疽卒，年五十二。

translations.literal: In the fourth year he died of carbuncle, aged fifty-two.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth year he died of carbuncle, at the age of fifty-two.

sentences.zh: 贈金紫光祿大夫，諡曰襄敏。

translations.literal: He was posthumously made Grand Master of the Gold Seal and Purple Ribbon, with the posthumous title Xiangmin.
translations.idiomatic: He was posthumously made Grand Master of the Gold Seal and Purple Ribbon, with the posthumous title Xiangmin, "Achieving and Keen."

sentences.zh: 韶起孤生，用兵有機略。

translations.literal: Shao rose from humble origins and in warfare had strategic resourcefulness.
translations.idiomatic: Shao rose from humble origins and in warfare had strategic resourcefulness.

sentences.zh: 臨出師，召諸將授以指，不復更問，每戰必捷。

translations.literal: Before setting out he summoned the generals and gave them their orders, never asking again; every battle was victorious.
translations.idiomatic: Before setting out he summoned the generals and gave them their orders, never asking again; every battle was victorious.

sentences.zh: 嘗夜臥帳中，前部遇敵，矢石已交，呼聲震山谷，侍者往往股栗，而韶鼻息自如。

translations.literal: Once he was sleeping in his tent at night when the vanguard met the enemy; arrows and stones were already flying, cries shook the valleys, attendants often trembled in the legs, yet Shao breathed as peacefully as ever.
translations.idiomatic: Once he was sleeping in his tent at night when the vanguard met the enemy; arrows and stones were already flying, cries shook the valleys, attendants often trembled in the legs, yet Shao breathed as peacefully as ever.

sentences.zh: 在鄂宴客，出家姬奏樂，客張繢醉挽一姬不前，將擁之，姬泣以告。

translations.literal: While entertaining guests at Ezhou, he had household singers perform; the guest Zhang Hui, drunk, seized one singer who would not come forward and was about to embrace her; she wept and told Shao.
translations.idiomatic: While entertaining guests at Ezhou, he had household singers perform; the guest Zhang Hui, drunk, seized one singer who would not come forward and was about to embrace her; she wept and told Shao.

sentences.zh: 韶徐曰：「本出汝曹娛客，而令失歡如此。

translations.literal: Shao said calmly: "They were sent out to entertain you, yet you have spoiled the pleasure like this."
translations.idiomatic: Shao said calmly, "They were sent out to entertain you, yet you have spoiled the pleasure like this."

sentences.zh: 」 命酌大杯罰之，談笑如故，人亦服其量。

translations.literal: He ordered a large cup to punish Hui, and conversed and laughed as before; people admired his magnanimity.
translations.idiomatic: He ordered a large cup to punish Hui, and conversed and laughed as before; people admired his magnanimity.

sentences.zh: 韶交親多楚人，依韶求仕，乃分屬諸將，或殺降羌老弱予以首為功級。

translations.literal: Many of Shao's associates and kin were men of Chu who sought office through him; he assigned them to various generals, and some killed surrendered Qiang, old and weak, presenting their heads for merit.
translations.idiomatic: Many of Shao's associates and kin were men of Chu who sought office through him; he assigned them to various generals, and some killed surrendered Qiang, old and weak, presenting their heads for merit.

sentences.zh: 韶晚節言動不常，頗若病狂狀。

translations.literal: In his later years Shao's words and conduct were irregular, rather like madness.
translations.idiomatic: In his later years Shao's words and conduct were irregular, rather like madness.

sentences.zh: 既病疽，洞見五髒，蓋亦多殺徵云。

translations.literal: When he fell ill with carbuncle he could see his five viscera exposed—perhaps a sign of excessive killing.
translations.idiomatic: When he fell ill with carbuncle he could see his five viscera exposed—perhaps a sign of excessive killing.

sentences.zh: 子十人，厚、寀最顯。

translations.literal: He had ten sons; Hou and Cai were the most prominent.
translations.idiomatic: He had ten sons; Hou and Cai were the most prominent.

sentences.zh: 子 厚

translations.literal: Son: Hou
translations.idiomatic: Son: Hou

sentences.zh: 厚，字處道。

translations.literal: Hou, style name Chudao.
translations.idiomatic: Hou, courtesy name Chudao.

sentences.zh: 少從父兵間，暢習羌事，官累通直郎。

translations.literal: From youth he followed his father in campaigns, thoroughly versed in Qiang affairs; he rose to Direct Attendant.
translations.idiomatic: From youth he followed his father in campaigns, thoroughly versed in Qiang affairs; he rose to Direct Attendant.

sentences.zh: 元祐棄河、湟，厚上疏陳不可，且詣政事堂言之，不聽。

translations.literal: When Yuanyou abandoned He and Huang, Hou submitted a memorial arguing against it and also went to the chief ministers' hall to speak; they would not listen.
translations.idiomatic: When Yuanyou abandoned He and Huang, Hou submitted a memorial arguing against it and also went to the chief ministers' hall to speak; they would not listen.

sentences.zh: 紹聖中，用薦者換禮賓副使、幹當熙河公事。

translations.literal: In the Shaosheng era, on recommendation he was transferred to Vice Commissioner of Ceremonial Reception and administrator of Xihe affairs.
translations.idiomatic: In the Shaosheng era, on recommendation he was transferred to Vice Commissioner of Ceremonial Reception and administrator of Xihe affairs.

sentences.zh: 會羌酋瞎征、隴拶爭國，河州守將王贍與厚同獻議復故地。

translations.literal: When Qiang chieftains Xiazheng and Longzhan contended for power, Hezhou garrison commander Wang Zhan and Hou jointly submitted a plan to recover the old territory.
translations.idiomatic: When Qiang chieftains Xiazheng and Longzhan contended for power, Hezhou garrison commander Wang Zhan and Hou jointly submitted a plan to recover the old territory.

sentences.zh: 元符元年六月，師出塞。

translations.literal: In the sixth month of the first year of Yuanfu, the army crossed the frontier.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month of the first year of Yuanfu, the army crossed the frontier.

sentences.zh: 七月，下邈川，降瞎征。

translations.literal: In the seventh month they took Miaochuan and Xiazheng submitted.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month they took Miaochuan and Xiazheng submitted.

sentences.zh: 九月，次青唐，隴拶出迎。

translations.literal: In the ninth month they halted at Qingtang; Longzhan came out to welcome them.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month they halted at Qingtang; Longzhan came out to welcome them.

sentences.zh: 遂定湟、鄯。

translations.literal: Thereupon Huang and Shan were settled.
translations.idiomatic: Thereupon Huang and Shan were settled.

sentences.zh: 詔賜隴拶姓名曰趙懷德，進厚東上閤門副使、知湟州。

translations.literal: An edict granted Longzhan the surname Zhao and the name Huaide; Hou was promoted to Vice Commissioner of the Eastern Upper Gate and made prefect of Huangzhou.
translations.idiomatic: An edict granted Longzhan the surname Zhao and the name Huaide; Hou was promoted to Vice Commissioner of the Eastern Upper Gate and made prefect of Huangzhou.

sentences.zh: 既而他種叛，合兵來攻，厚不能支。

translations.literal: Soon other tribes rebelled, combined forces to attack, and Hou could not hold them.
translations.idiomatic: Soon other tribes rebelled, combined forces to attack, and Hou could not hold them.

sentences.zh: 朝廷度二州不可守，乃以畀懷德，而貶厚右內府率，再貶賀州別駕。

translations.literal: The court judged the two prefectures indefensible, therefore ceded them to Huaide, and demoted Hou to Right Inner Palace Attendant, then again to Vice Prefect of Hezhou.
translations.idiomatic: The court judged the two prefectures indefensible, therefore ceded them to Huaide, and demoted Hou to Right Inner Palace Attendant, then again to Vice Prefect of Hezhou.

sentences.zh: 崇寧初，蔡京復開邊，還厚前秩，於是羌人多羅巴奉懷德之弟溪賒羅撒謀復國。

translations.literal: At the start of Chongning, Cai Jing reopened the frontier and restored Hou's former rank; then the Qiang Duoluoba supported Huaide's younger brother Xisheluosuo to plot restoration.
translations.idiomatic: At the start of Chongning, Cai Jing reopened the frontier and restored Hou's former rank; then the Qiang Duoluoba supported Huaide's younger brother Xisheluosuo to plot restoration.

sentences.zh: 懷德畏逼，奔河南，種落更挾之以令諸部。

translations.literal: Huaide, fearing coercion, fled to Henan; the tribes further used him to command the various divisions.
translations.idiomatic: Huaide, fearing coercion, fled to Henan; the tribes further used him to command the various divisions.

sentences.zh: 朝廷患眾羌扇結，命厚安撫洮西，遣內客省使童貫偕往。

translations.literal: The court, troubled that the Qiang were fanning unrest, ordered Hou to pacify the west of the Tao and sent Palace Envoy Tong Guan to accompany him.
translations.idiomatic: The court, troubled that the Qiang were fanning unrest, ordered Hou to pacify the west of the Tao and sent Palace Envoy Tong Guan to accompany him.

sentences.zh: 多羅巴知王師且至，集眾以拒。

translations.literal: Duoluoba, knowing the imperial army was about to arrive, gathered his forces to resist.
translations.idiomatic: Duoluoba, knowing the imperial army was about to arrive, gathered his forces to resist.

sentences.zh: 厚聲言駐兵而陰戒行，羌備益弛，乃與偏將高永年異道出。

translations.literal: Hou publicly announced he would halt his troops but secretly ordered the march; Qiang defenses grew lax, and he advanced with subordinate general Gao Yongnian by a separate route.
translations.idiomatic: Hou publicly announced he would halt his troops but secretly ordered the march; Qiang defenses grew lax, and he advanced with subordinate general Gao Yongnian by a separate route.

sentences.zh: 多羅巴三子以數萬人分據險，厚進擊破殺之，唯少子阿蒙中流矢去，道遇多羅巴，與俱遁。

translations.literal: Duoluoba's three sons held the defiles with tens of thousands; Hou advanced, attacked, and killed them; only the youngest, Ameng, was struck by a stray arrow and fled; on the road he met Duoluoba and both escaped.
translations.idiomatic: Duoluoba's three sons held the defiles with tens of thousands; Hou advanced, attacked, and killed them; only the youngest, Ameng, was struck by a stray arrow and fled; on the road he met Duoluoba and both escaped.

sentences.zh: 遂拔湟州。

translations.literal: Thereupon Huangzhou was taken.
translations.idiomatic: Thereupon Huangzhou was taken.

sentences.zh: 以功進威州團練使、熙河經略安撫。

translations.literal: For his merit he was promoted to Military Commissioner of Weizhou and Xihe frontier commissioner and pacifier.
translations.idiomatic: For his merit he was promoted to Military Commissioner of Weizhou and Xihe frontier commissioner and pacifier.

sentences.zh: 三年四月，厚帥大軍次於湟，命永年將左軍循宗水而北，別將張誡將右軍出宗谷而南，自將中軍趨綏遠，期會宗哥川，羌置陳臨宗水，倚北山，溪賒羅撒張黃屋，建大旆，乘高指呼，望中軍旗鼓爭赴之。

translations.literal: In the fourth month of the third year, Hou led the main army and halted at Huang; he ordered Yongnian to command the left wing along the Zong River northward, subordinate general Zhang Jie the right wing out the Zong Valley southward, and himself led the center toward Suiyuan, to rendezvous at Zongge River. The Qiang deployed facing the Zong River, leaning on the northern mountains; Xisheluosuo spread a yellow canopy, raised a great banner, and from the heights shouted commands; seeing the center army's flags and drums, they all rushed toward it.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month of the third year, Hou led the main army and halted at Huang; he ordered Yongnian to command the left wing along the Zong River northward, subordinate general Zhang Jie the right wing out the Zong Valley southward, and himself led the center toward Suiyuan, to rendezvous at Zongge River. The Qiang deployed facing the Zong River, leaning on the northern mountains; Xisheluosuo spread a yellow canopy, raised a great banner, and from the heights shouted commands; seeing the center army's flags and drums, they all rushed toward it.

sentences.zh: 厚麾遊騎登山攻其背，親帥強弩迎射，羌退走，右軍濟水擊之，大風從東南來，揚沙翳羌目，不得視，遂大敗，斬首四千三百餘級，俘三千餘人。

translations.literal: Hou commanded skirmishers to climb the mountain and attack their rear, personally led strong crossbowmen to shoot them down; the Qiang retreated, the right wing crossed the water and struck them; a great wind came from the southeast, whirling sand and blinding the Qiang so they could not see; they were utterly defeated—more than four thousand three hundred beheaded and more than three thousand captured.
translations.idiomatic: Hou commanded skirmishers to climb the mountain and attack their rear, personally led strong crossbowmen to shoot them down; the Qiang retreated, the right wing crossed the water and struck them; a great wind came from the southeast, whirling sand and blinding the Qiang so they could not see; they were utterly defeated—more than four thousand three hundred beheaded and more than three thousand captured.

sentences.zh: 羅撒以一騎馳去，其母龜茲公主與諸酋開鄯州降。

translations.literal: Luosuo fled on a single horse; his mother, the Kuche Princess, and the various chieftains opened Shanzhou and submitted.
translations.idiomatic: Luosuo fled on a single horse; his mother, the Kuche Princess, and the various chieftains opened Shanzhou and submitted.

sentences.zh: 厚計羅撒必且走青唐，將夜追之，童貫以為不能及，遂止。

translations.literal: Hou reckoned Luosuo would surely flee to Qingtang and planned a night pursuit; Tong Guan thought they could not catch him and stopped it.
translations.idiomatic: Hou reckoned Luosuo would surely flee to Qingtang and planned a night pursuit; Tong Guan thought they could not catch him and stopped it.

sentences.zh: 師下青唐，知羅撒留一宿去，貫始悔之。

translations.literal: When the army reached Qingtang they learned Luosuo had stayed one night and left; Guan then regretted it.
translations.idiomatic: When the army reached Qingtang they learned Luosuo had stayed one night and left; Guan then regretted it.

sentences.zh: 厚將大軍趣廓州，酋落施軍令結以眾降，遂入廓州。

translations.literal: Hou led the main army toward Kuozhou; chieftain Shijunlingjie submitted with his followers, and they entered Kuozhou.
translations.idiomatic: Hou led the main army toward Kuozhou; chieftain Shijunlingjie submitted with his followers, and they entered Kuozhou.

sentences.zh: 超拜厚武勝軍節度觀察留後。

translations.literal: Hou was specially promoted to Military Commissioner and Observation Commissioner of Wusheng Army.
translations.idiomatic: Hou was specially promoted to Military Commissioner and Observation Commissioner of Wusheng Army.

sentences.zh: 明年，羅撒復入寇，永年戰死，羌焚大通河橋以叛，新疆大震。

translations.literal: The next year Luosuo again invaded; Yongnian died in battle; the Qiang burned the Datong River bridge and rebelled; the new territories were greatly shaken.
translations.idiomatic: The next year Luosuo again invaded; Yongnian died in battle; the Qiang burned the Datong River bridge and rebelled; the new territories were greatly shaken.

sentences.zh: 厚坐逗遛，降郢州防禦使。

translations.literal: Hou was punished for delay and demoted to Defender of Yingzhou.
translations.idiomatic: Hou was punished for delay and demoted to Defender of Yingzhou.

sentences.zh: 已而趙懷德約降未決，厚以書諭之，懷德即納款。

translations.literal: Before long Zhao Huaide's agreement to submit was still unsettled; Hou sent a letter urging him, and Huaide at once pledged allegiance.
translations.idiomatic: Before long Zhao Huaide's agreement to submit was still unsettled; Hou sent a letter urging him, and Huaide at once pledged allegiance.

sentences.zh: 還厚舊官。

translations.literal: Hou's former rank was restored.
translations.idiomatic: Hou's former rank was restored.

sentences.zh: 入朝，提舉醴泉觀，卒。

translations.literal: He entered court, was made commissioner of the Liquan Abbey, and died.
translations.idiomatic: He entered court, was made commissioner of the Liquan Abbey, and died.

sentences.zh: 贈寧遠軍節度使，諡曰「莊敏」。

translations.literal: He was posthumously made Military Commissioner of Ningyuan Army, with the posthumous title "Zhuangmin."
translations.idiomatic: He was posthumously made Military Commissioner of Ningyuan Army, with the posthumous title Zhuangmin, "Solemn and Keen."

sentences.zh: 子 寀

translations.literal: Son: Cai
translations.idiomatic: Son: Cai

sentences.zh: 寀，字輔道。

translations.literal: Cai, style name Fudao.
translations.idiomatic: Cai, courtesy name Fudao.

sentences.zh: 好學，工詞章。

translations.literal: He loved learning and was skilled in literary composition.
translations.idiomatic: He loved learning and was skilled in literary composition.

sentences.zh: 登第，至校書郎。

translations.literal: He passed the examinations and rose to collator.
translations.idiomatic: He passed the examinations and rose to collator.

sentences.zh: 忽若有所睹，遂感心疾，唯好延道流談丹砂、神仙事。

translations.literal: Suddenly it was as though he saw something; he then developed a mental illness and cared only to invite Daoist priests to discuss cinnabar and immortal matters.
translations.idiomatic: Suddenly it was as though he saw something; he then developed a mental illness and cared only to invite Daoist priests to discuss cinnabar and immortality.

sentences.zh: 得鄭州書生，託左道，自言天神可祈而下，下則聲容與人接。

translations.literal: He obtained a Zhengzhou scholar who practiced heterodox arts and claimed that celestial spirits could be invoked to descend; when they descended, their voice and appearance mingled with men.
translations.idiomatic: He obtained a Zhengzhou scholar who practiced heterodox arts and claimed that celestial spirits could be invoked to descend; when they descended, their voice and appearance mingled with men.

sentences.zh: 因習行其術，才能什七八，須兩人共為乃驗。

translations.literal: He practiced the technique and could perform seven or eight tenths of it; two people had to act together for it to work.
translations.idiomatic: He practiced the technique and could perform seven or eight tenths of it; two people had to act together for it to work.

sentences.zh: 外間讙傳，浸淫徹禁庭。

translations.literal: Rumors spread outside and gradually reached the inner palace.
translations.idiomatic: Rumors spread outside and gradually reached the inner palace.

sentences.zh: 徽宗方崇道教，侍晨林靈素自度技不如，願與之遊，拒弗許。

translations.literal: Emperor Huizong was then promoting Daoism; Attendant-at-Court Lin Lingsu, judging his own skill inferior, wished to associate with Cai, but was refused.
translations.idiomatic: Emperor Huizong was then promoting Daoism; Attendant-at-Court Lin Lingsu, judging his own skill inferior, wished to associate with Cai, but was refused.

sentences.zh: 戶部尚書劉昺，寀外兄也，久以爭進絕還往，神降寀家，使因昺以達，寀言其故，神曰：「第往與之言，汝某年月日在蔡京後堂談某事，有之否？

translations.literal: Minister of Revenue Liu Bing was Cai's maternal cousin; long estranged over competing for advancement, a spirit descended at Cai's house and had him reach Liu through Bing; Cai explained the reason. The spirit said: "Just go speak with him—on such-and-such a day in such-and-such a year you discussed such-and-such a matter in Cai Jing's rear hall—is it so or not?"
translations.idiomatic: Minister of Revenue Liu Bing was Cai's maternal cousin; long estranged over competing for advancement, a spirit descended at Cai's house and had him reach Liu through Bing; Cai explained the reason. The spirit said, "Just go speak with him—on such-and-such a day in such-and-such a year you discussed such-and-such a matter in Cai Jing's rear hall—is it so or not?"

sentences.zh: 」昺驚駭汗洽，不能對，蓋所言皆陰中傷人者。

translations.literal: Bing was shocked, sweat streaming, unable to reply—for what was said were all secret slanders of others.
translations.idiomatic: Bing was shocked, sweat streaming, unable to reply—for what was said were all secret slanders of others.

sentences.zh: 乃言之帝，即召。

translations.literal: He then told the emperor, and Cai was summoned.
translations.idiomatic: He then told the emperor, and Cai was summoned.

sentences.zh: 寀風儀既高，又善談論，應對合上指。

translations.literal: Cai's bearing was lofty and he was skilled in discourse; his responses pleased the emperor.
translations.idiomatic: Cai's bearing was lofty and he was skilled in discourse; his responses pleased the emperor.

sentences.zh: 帝大喜，約某日即內殿致天神。

translations.literal: The emperor was greatly pleased and set a date to summon the celestial spirit in the inner hall.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor was greatly pleased and set a date to summon the celestial spirit in the inner hall.

sentences.zh: 靈素求與共事，又弗許。

translations.literal: Lingsu asked to assist in the affair and was again refused.
translations.idiomatic: Lingsu asked to assist in the affair and was again refused.

sentences.zh: 或謂靈素，但勿令鄭書生偕，寀當立敗。

translations.literal: Someone told Lingsu: "Just do not let the Zhengzhou scholar accompany him, and Cai will fail at once."
translations.idiomatic: Someone told Lingsu, "Just do not let the Zhengzhou scholar accompany him, and Cai will fail at once."

sentences.zh: 即白帝曰：「寀父兄昔在西邊，密與夏人謀反國。

translations.literal: He immediately reported to the emperor: "Cai's father and elder brother formerly on the western frontier secretly plotted rebellion with the Western Xia.
translations.idiomatic: He immediately reported to the emperor, "Cai's father and elder brother formerly on the western frontier secretly plotted rebellion with the Western Xia.

sentences.zh: 遲至尊候神，且圖不軌。

translations.literal: Waiting for Your Majesty to summon the spirit, they also plot sedition."
translations.idiomatic: Waiting for Your Majesty to summon the spirit, they also plot sedition."

sentences.zh: 」帝疑焉。

translations.literal: The emperor grew suspicious.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor grew suspicious.

sentences.zh: 及是日，寀與書生至東華門，靈素戒閽卒獨聽寀入。

translations.literal: On the appointed day Cai and the scholar reached the Donghua Gate; Lingsu instructed the gate guards to admit Cai alone.
translations.idiomatic: On the appointed day Cai and the scholar reached the Donghua Gate; Lingsu instructed the gate guards to admit Cai alone.

sentences.zh: 帝齋潔敬待，越三夕無所聞，乃下寀大理，獄成，棄市，昺竄瓊州。

translations.literal: The emperor fasted and waited reverently; after three nights with no word, he sent Cai to the Court of Judicial Review; when the case was complete, Cai was executed in the marketplace and Bing was exiled to Qiongzhou.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor fasted and waited reverently; after three nights with no word, he sent Cai to the Court of Judicial Review; when the case was complete, Cai was executed in the marketplace and Bing was exiled to Qiongzhou.

sentences.zh: 薛向，字師正。

translations.literal: Xue Xiang, style name Shizheng.
translations.idiomatic: Xue Xiang, courtesy name Shizheng.

sentences.zh: 以祖顏任太廟齋郎，為永壽主簿，權京兆戶曹。

translations.literal: Through his grandfather Yan's office as Temple Acolyte, he served as registrar of Yongshou and acting revenue officer of the Capital District.
translations.idiomatic: Through his grandfather Yan's office as Temple Acolyte, he served as registrar of Yongshou and acting revenue officer of the Capital District.

sentences.zh: 有商胡齎銀二篋，出樞密使王德用書，云以與其弟。

translations.literal: A merchant from the Western Regions carried two chests of silver with a letter from Military Affairs Commissioner Wang Deyong, saying it was for his younger brother.
translations.idiomatic: A merchant from the Western Regions carried two chests of silver with a letter from Military Affairs Commissioner Wang Deyong, saying it was for his younger brother.

sentences.zh: 向適監稅，疑之曰：「烏有大臣寄家問而諉胡人者？

translations.literal: Xiang was then supervising tax collection and suspected it, saying: "How could a great minister send family correspondence through a foreign merchant?"
translations.idiomatic: Xiang was then supervising tax collection and suspected it, saying, "How could a great minister send family correspondence through a foreign merchant?"

sentences.zh: 」鞫之，果妄。

translations.literal: He interrogated them and it proved false.
translations.idiomatic: He interrogated them and it proved false.

sentences.zh: 為邠州司法參軍。

translations.literal: He served as judicial administrator of Binzhou.
translations.idiomatic: He served as judicial administrator of Binzhou.

sentences.zh: 夏人叛，秦中治城，侍御史陳洎行邊，向詣洎陳三敝，言：「今板築暴興，吏持斧四出伐木，無問井閭丘隴，民不敢訴。

translations.literal: When the Western Xia rebelled, Qinzhong repaired city walls; Censor Chen Ji toured the frontier; Xiang went to Ji and set forth three abuses, saying: "Now construction surges everywhere; clerks with axes go out in all directions to cut timber, heedless of villages, lanes, mounds, and ridges, and the people dare not complain."
translations.idiomatic: When the Western Xia rebelled, Qinzhong repaired city walls; Censor Chen Ji toured the frontier; Xiang went to Ji and set forth three abuses, saying, "Now construction surges everywhere; clerks with axes go out in all directions to cut timber, heedless of villages, lanes, mounds, and ridges, and the people dare not complain."

sentences.zh: 必不得已，宜且葺邊城。

translations.literal: If it cannot be avoided, we should for now repair only the border cities.
translations.idiomatic: If it cannot be avoided, we should for now repair only the border cities.

sentences.zh: 函關，秦東塞，今西向設守，是為棄關內乎？

translations.literal: Hangu Pass is Qin's eastern barrier; now setting guards facing west—is this not abandoning the pass to the interior?
translations.idiomatic: Hangu Pass is Qin's eastern barrier; now setting guards facing west—is this not abandoning the pass to the interior?

sentences.zh: 三司貸龍門富人錢，以百年全盛之天下，一方有警，即稱貸於民，非義也。

translations.literal: The Three Departments Commission borrowed money from the rich of Longmen; in a century of full prosperity, when one region has an alarm they immediately borrow from the people—this is not righteous.
translations.idiomatic: The Three Departments Commission borrowed money from the rich of Longmen; in a century of full prosperity, when one region has an alarm they immediately borrow from the people—this is not righteous.

sentences.zh: 」洎上其說，悉從之。

translations.literal: Ji memorialized his proposals and all were adopted.
translations.idiomatic: Ji memorialized his proposals and all were adopted.

sentences.zh: 邠守貪遝，欲因事為邪，並治於城，立表於市以撤屋，冀得賂免，向力爭罷之。

translations.literal: The prefect of Bin was greedy and corrupt and wished to use the occasion for wrongdoing; he would combine repairs at the city and set up markers in the market to demolish houses, hoping to obtain bribes for exemption; Xiang argued strenuously and had it stopped.
translations.idiomatic: The prefect of Bin was greedy and corrupt and wished to use the occasion for wrongdoing; he would combine repairs at the city and set up markers in the market to demolish houses, hoping to obtain bribes for exemption; Xiang argued strenuously and had it stopped.

sentences.zh: 監在京榷貨務，連歲羨緡錢，當遷秩，移與其兄。

translations.literal: Supervising the Capital Monopoly Bureau, for successive years surplus cash was recorded; he should have been promoted in rank but transferred the credit to his elder brother.
translations.idiomatic: Supervising the Capital Monopoly Bureau, for successive years surplus cash was recorded; he should have been promoted in rank but transferred the credit to his elder brother.

sentences.zh: 三司判官董沔議改河北便糴，行鈔法。

translations.literal: Three Departments judicial officer Dong Mian proposed changing Hebei's convenient grain purchase and implementing the note system.
translations.idiomatic: Three Departments judicial officer Dong Mian proposed changing Hebei's convenient grain purchase and implementing the note system.

sentences.zh: 向曰：「如此，則都內之錢不繼，茶、鹽、香、象將益不售矣。

translations.literal: Xiang said: "If this is done, capital funds will not flow, and tea, salt, incense, and ivory will sell even less."
translations.idiomatic: Xiang said, "If this is done, capital funds will not flow, and tea, salt, incense, and ivory will sell even less."

sentences.zh: 」有司主沔議，既而邊糴滯不行，沔坐黜。

translations.literal: The relevant offices supported Mian's proposal; soon border grain purchases stalled and would not proceed, and Mian was demoted.
translations.idiomatic: The relevant offices supported Mian's proposal; soon border grain purchases stalled and would not proceed, and Mian was demoted.

sentences.zh: 以向知鄜州。

translations.literal: Xiang was made prefect of Yanzhou.
translations.idiomatic: Xiang was made prefect of Yanzhou.

sentences.zh: 大水冒城郭，沉室廬，死者相枕。

translations.literal: Great floods submerged the city walls, sank houses, and the dead lay piled one upon another.
translations.idiomatic: Great floods submerged the city walls, sank houses, and the dead lay piled one upon another.

sentences.zh: 郡卒戍延安，詣主將求歸視弗得，皆亡奔。

translations.literal: Prefectural soldiers garrisoned at Yan'an went to their commander seeking leave to return home to look after affairs and were refused; all fled.
translations.idiomatic: Prefectural soldiers garrisoned at Yan'an went to their commander seeking leave to return home to look after affairs and were refused; all fled.

sentences.zh: 至，則家人無存者，聚謀為盜，民大恐。

translations.literal: When they arrived, not one of their families remained; they gathered to plot banditry, and the people were greatly alarmed.
translations.idiomatic: When they arrived, not one of their families remained; they gathered to plot banditry, and the people were greatly alarmed.

sentences.zh: 向遣吏曉之曰：「冒法以赴急，人之常情，而不聽若輩歸，此武將不知變之過也。

translations.literal: Xiang sent an official to explain: "Breaking the law to meet an emergency is human nature; that you were not allowed to return is the fault of the military commander for not knowing how to adapt."
translations.idiomatic: Xiang sent an official to explain, "Breaking the law to meet an emergency is human nature; that you were not allowed to return is the fault of the military commander for not knowing how to adapt."

sentences.zh: 亟往收溺屍，貰汝擅還之罪。

translations.literal: Go quickly and recover the drowned corpses, and I will pardon your offense of returning without leave."
translations.idiomatic: Go quickly and recover the drowned corpses, and I will pardon your offense of returning without leave."

sentences.zh: 」眾入庭下泣謝，一境乃安。

translations.literal: The crowd entered the courtyard weeping in thanks, and the whole region was pacified.
translations.idiomatic: The crowd entered the courtyard weeping in thanks, and the whole region was pacified.

sentences.zh: 又論河北糴法之弊，以為：「度支歲費錢緡五百萬，所得半直，其贏皆入賈販家。

translations.literal: He also discussed the abuses of the Hebei grain-purchase system, holding: "The Revenue Bureau spends five million strings of cash each year; what is obtained is half value, and the profit all goes to merchant houses."
translations.idiomatic: He also discussed the abuses of the Hebei grain-purchase system, holding, "The Revenue Bureau spends five million strings of cash each year; what is obtained is half value, and the profit all goes to merchant houses."

sentences.zh: 今當有以權之，遇穀貴，則官糴於澶，魏，載以給邊；

translations.literal: Now we should have means to regulate it: when grain is dear, the government should purchase at Chan and Wei and transport it to supply the frontier;
translations.idiomatic: Now we should have means to regulate it: when grain is dear, the government should purchase at Chan and Wei and transport it to supply the frontier;

sentences.zh: 新陳未交，則散糴價以救民乏；

translations.literal: when old and new stores have not yet rotated, release purchase price to relieve the people's want;
translations.idiomatic: when old and new stores have not yet rotated, release purchase price to relieve the people's want;

sentences.zh: 軍食有餘，則坐倉收之。

translations.literal: when army provisions are surplus, collect them in the granaries.
translations.idiomatic: when army provisions are surplus, collect them in the granaries.

sentences.zh: 此策一行，穀將不可勝食矣。

translations.literal: Once this policy is implemented, grain will be more than can be consumed."
translations.idiomatic: Once this policy is implemented, grain will be more than can be consumed."

sentences.zh: 」朝廷是向計，始置便糴司於大名，以向為提點刑獄兼其事。

translations.literal: The court approved Xiang's plan and first established the Convenient Purchase Office at Daming, with Xiang as judicial commissioner overseeing it.
translations.idiomatic: The court approved Xiang's plan and first established the Convenient Purchase Office at Daming, with Xiang as judicial commissioner overseeing it.

sentences.zh: 武強有盜殺人而逸，尉捕平民抑使承，向覆其冤，脫六囚於死。

translations.literal: At Wuqiang a bandit killed a man and fled; the sheriff seized a commoner and coerced a confession; Xiang reviewed the case, found the injustice, and freed six prisoners from death.
translations.idiomatic: At Wuqiang a bandit killed a man and fled; the sheriff seized a commoner and coerced a confession; Xiang reviewed the case, found the injustice, and freed six prisoners from death.

sentences.zh: 入為開封度支判官，權陝西轉運副使、制置解鹽。

translations.literal: He entered court as revenue judicial officer of Kaifeng, acting vice transport commissioner of Shaanxi and commissioner for Jie Salt.
translations.idiomatic: He entered court as revenue judicial officer of Kaifeng, acting vice transport commissioner of Shaanxi and commissioner for Jie Salt.

sentences.zh: 鹽足支十年，而歲調畦夫數千，向奏損其數。

translations.literal: Salt was sufficient for ten years, yet thousands of saltern laborers were levied each year; Xiang memorialized to reduce the number.
translations.idiomatic: Salt was sufficient for ten years, yet thousands of saltern laborers were levied each year; Xiang memorialized to reduce the number.

sentences.zh: 兼提舉買馬，監牧沙苑養馬，歲得駒三百，而費錢四千萬，占田千頃。

translations.literal: Concurrently commissioner for horse purchase and supervisor of pasture at Shanyuan; raising horses there yielded three hundred foals a year at a cost of forty million cash and occupation of one thousand qing of land.
translations.idiomatic: Concurrently commissioner for horse purchase and supervisor of pasture at Shanyuan; raising horses there yielded three hundred foals a year at a cost of forty million cash and occupation of one thousand qing of land.

sentences.zh: 向請斥閑田予民，收租入以市之。

translations.literal: Xiang requested idle land be granted to the people and rent collected to purchase horses.
translations.idiomatic: Xiang requested idle land be granted to the people and rent collected to purchase horses.

sentences.zh: 乃置場於原、渭，以羨鹽之直市馬，於是馬一歲至萬匹。

translations.literal: A market was then established at Yuan and Wei to buy horses with surplus salt revenue; thus horses reached ten thousand in a year.
translations.idiomatic: A market was then established at Yuan and Wei to buy horses with surplus salt revenue; thus horses reached ten thousand in a year.

sentences.zh: 昭陵復土，計用錢糧五十萬貫石，三司不能供億，將移陝西緣邊入鹽中於永安縣。

translations.literal: For reinterment at Zhaoling, funds and grain totaling five hundred thousand were estimated; the Three Departments Commission could not supply it and planned to move Shaanxi frontier salt revenue to Yong'an County.
translations.idiomatic: For reinterment at Zhaoling, funds and grain totaling five hundred thousand were estimated; the Three Departments Commission could not supply it and planned to move Shaanxi frontier salt revenue to Yong'an County.

sentences.zh: 向陳五不可，以為失信商旅，遂舉所闕之數以獻。

translations.literal: Xiang set forth five reasons why this should not be done, holding it would break faith with merchants, and then offered the full amount lacking.
translations.idiomatic: Xiang set forth five reasons why this should not be done, holding it would break faith with merchants, and then offered the full amount lacking.

sentences.zh: 嘗夜至靈寶縣，先驅入驛，與客崔令孫爭舍。

translations.literal: Once at night he reached Lingbao County; his advance guard entered the post station and disputed quarters with the guest Cui Lingsun.
translations.idiomatic: Once at night he reached Lingbao County; his advance guard entered the post station and disputed quarters with the guest Cui Lingsun.

sentences.zh: 令孫正病臥，驚而死，罷知汝州。

translations.literal: Lingsun was lying ill and died of fright; Xiang was removed as prefect of Ruzhou.
translations.idiomatic: Lingsun was lying ill and died of fright; Xiang was removed as prefect of Ruzhou.

sentences.zh: 甫數月，復以為陝西轉運副使，進為使。

translations.literal: After only a few months he was again made vice transport commissioner of Shaanxi and then promoted to commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: After only a few months he was again made vice transport commissioner of Shaanxi and then promoted to commissioner.

sentences.zh: 厚陵役費，其助如永昭時，凡將漕八年，所入鹽、馬、芻、粟數累萬，民不益賦，其課為最。

translations.literal: For the Houling project the costs matched those of Yongzhao; in all he directed transport for eight years; revenue from salt, horses, fodder, and grain totaled tens of thousands; the people paid no added levies, and his performance rating was highest.
translations.idiomatic: For the Houling project the costs matched those of Yongzhao; in all he directed transport for eight years; revenue from salt, horses, fodder, and grain totaled tens of thousands; the people paid no added levies, and his performance rating was highest.

sentences.zh: 夏將嵬名山以綏州來歸，青澗城主种諤將往迎，詔向與議。

translations.literal: Western Xia general Wei Mingshan came over with Suizhou; Qingjian city commander Chong E was about to go welcome him; an edict ordered Xiang to join in deliberation.
translations.idiomatic: Western Xia general Wei Mingshan came over with Suizhou; Qingjian city commander Chong E was about to go welcome him; an edict ordered Xiang to join in deliberation.

sentences.zh: 諤不俟命，亟率所部出塞，遂城之。

translations.literal: E did not await orders but urgently led his command across the frontier and fortified the place.
translations.idiomatic: E did not await orders but urgently led his command across the frontier and fortified the place.

sentences.zh: 廷議劾諤擅興，將致法。

translations.literal: Court debate impeached E for unauthorized action and was about to punish him by law.
translations.idiomatic: Court debate impeached E for unauthorized action and was about to punish him by law.

sentences.zh: 向言：「諤今者之舉，蓋忘身以徇國，有如不稱，臣請坐之。

translations.literal: Xiang said: "E's present action was forgetting self to serve the state; if it does not succeed, I request to be punished in his stead."
translations.idiomatic: Xiang said, "E's present action was forgetting self to serve the state; if it does not succeed, I request to be punished in his stead."

sentences.zh: 」諤既貶，向亦罷知絳州，再貶信州，移潞州。

translations.literal: E was demoted; Xiang was also removed as prefect of Jiangzhou, demoted again to Xinzhou, and transferred to Luzhou.
translations.idiomatic: E was demoted; Xiang was also removed as prefect of Jiangzhou, demoted again to Xinzhou, and transferred to Luzhou.

sentences.zh: 張靖使陝西還，陳向制置鹽、馬之失。

translations.literal: Zhang Jing returned from mission to Shaanxi and set forth Xiang's failures in managing salt and horses.
translations.idiomatic: Zhang Jing returned from mission to Shaanxi and set forth Xiang's failures in managing salt and horses.

sentences.zh: 詔向詣闕與辯，靖辭窮，即罪之。

translations.literal: An edict ordered Xiang to come to court to debate; Jing's arguments failed and he was punished.
translations.idiomatic: An edict ordered Xiang to come to court to debate; Jing's arguments failed and he was punished.

sentences.zh: 神宗知向材，以為江、浙、荊、淮發運使。

translations.literal: Emperor Shenzong knew Xiang's talent and made him transport commissioner for Jiang, Zhe, Jing, and Huai.
translations.idiomatic: Emperor Shenzong knew Xiang's talent and made him transport commissioner for Jiang, Zhe, Jing, and Huai.

sentences.zh: 綱舟曆歲久，篙工利於盜貨，嘗假風水沉溺以滅跡。

translations.literal: The convoy boats had been in service many years; boatmen profited from stealing cargo and sometimes feigned wind and water to sink boats and destroy traces.
translations.idiomatic: The convoy boats had been in service many years; boatmen profited from stealing cargo and sometimes feigned wind and water to sink boats and destroy traces.

sentences.zh: 向募客舟分載，以相督察。

translations.literal: Xiang recruited merchant boats to share the load for mutual oversight.
translations.idiomatic: Xiang recruited merchant boats to share the load for mutual oversight.

sentences.zh: 官舟有定數，多為主者冒占，悉奪畀屬州，諸運皆詣本曹受遣；

translations.literal: Official boats had fixed quotas but many were falsely held by their masters; all were seized and assigned to subordinate prefectures; all transport went to the bureau for dispatch;
translations.idiomatic: Official boats had fixed quotas but many were falsely held by their masters; all were seized and assigned to subordinate prefectures; all transport went to the bureau for dispatch;

sentences.zh: 以地有美惡，利有重輕，為立等式，用所漕物為誅賞。

translations.literal: since lands differed in quality and profits in weight, grades were established and transported goods used for rewards and punishments.
translations.idiomatic: since lands differed in quality and profits in weight, grades were established and transported goods used for rewards and punishments.

sentences.zh: 遷天章閣待制。

translations.literal: He was transferred to editorial acolyte of the Tianzhang Pavilion.
translations.idiomatic: He was transferred to editorial acolyte of the Tianzhang Pavilion.

sentences.zh: 環慶有疆事，帝以向習知地形，召詣中書。

translations.literal: When Huan and Qing had a border affair, the emperor, knowing Xiang was familiar with the terrain, summoned him to the Secretariat.
translations.idiomatic: When Huan and Qing had a border affair, the emperor, knowing Xiang was familiar with the terrain, summoned him to the Secretariat.

sentences.zh: 舊制，發運使上計，毋得出入，唯止都門達章奏。

translations.literal: By old regulation, when the transport commissioner presented accounts he might not enter or leave; he could only stop at the capital gate to deliver memorials.
translations.idiomatic: By old regulation, when the transport commissioner presented accounts he might not enter or leave; he could only stop at the capital gate to deliver memorials.

sentences.zh: 至是，弛其禁。

translations.literal: At this the prohibition was relaxed.
translations.idiomatic: At this the prohibition was relaxed.

sentences.zh: 熙寧四年，權三司使。

translations.literal: In the fourth year of Xining he was acting commissioner of the Three Departments.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth year of Xining he was acting commissioner of the Three Departments.

sentences.zh: 明堂禮成，有司誤遷向右諫議大夫，詔罰吏而向官不奪。

translations.literal: When the Bright Hall rites were completed, the relevant offices mistakenly promoted him to Right Remonstrance Grand Master; an edict punished the clerks but did not strip Xiang's office.
translations.idiomatic: When the Bright Hall rites were completed, the relevant offices mistakenly promoted him to Right Remonstrance Grand Master; an edict punished the clerks but did not strip Xiang's office.

sentences.zh: 河、洮用兵，縣官費不可計，向未嘗乏供給。

translations.literal: For the He and Tao campaigns, state expenses were beyond reckoning, yet Xiang never failed in supply.
translations.idiomatic: For the He and Tao campaigns, state expenses were beyond reckoning, yet Xiang never failed in supply.

sentences.zh: 及解嚴，上疏乞戒將帥裁溢員，汰冗卒、省浮費、節橫賦，手敕褒納。

translations.literal: When the emergency ended he submitted a memorial begging the emperor to warn generals, cut excess posts, eliminate redundant soldiers, reduce wasteful spending, and restrain arbitrary levies; the emperor personally wrote in praise and acceptance.
translations.idiomatic: When the emergency ended he submitted a memorial begging the emperor to warn generals, cut excess posts, eliminate redundant soldiers, reduce wasteful spending, and restrain arbitrary levies; the emperor personally wrote in praise and acceptance.

sentences.zh: 進龍圖閣直學士。

translations.literal: He was promoted to direct academician of the Longtu Pavilion.
translations.idiomatic: He was promoted to direct academician of the Longtu Pavilion.

sentences.zh: 遼人求代北地，北邊擇牧，加樞密直學士、給事中、知定州。

translations.literal: The Khitan sought northern Dai territory; the northern frontier chose pastures; he was made direct academician of the Bureau of Military Affairs, Supervising Censor, and prefect of Dingzhou.
translations.idiomatic: The Khitan sought northern Dai territory; the northern frontier chose pastures; he was made direct academician of the Bureau of Military Affairs, Supervising Censor, and prefect of Dingzhou.

sentences.zh: 高陽關募兵，敵陰遣人應選。

translations.literal: At Gaoyang Pass troops were recruited; the enemy secretly sent men to enlist.
translations.idiomatic: At Gaoyang Pass troops were recruited; the enemy secretly sent men to enlist.

sentences.zh: 向諜知之，主者覺，縱使亡去，向遣邏捕取之，械送瀛州，戮於市。

translations.literal: Xiang learned through spies; the recruiter noticed, let them escape; Xiang sent pursuers to seize them, sent them in fetters to Yingzhou, and executed them in the marketplace.
translations.idiomatic: Xiang learned through spies; the recruiter noticed, let them escape; Xiang sent pursuers to seize them, sent them in fetters to Yingzhou, and executed them in the marketplace.

sentences.zh: 北使久留都亭，數出不遜語，而雲、應點兵，涿、易治道，僉謂必諭盟。

translations.literal: The northern envoy long remained at Duting; several times he uttered insolent words; meanwhile Yun and Ying mobilized troops and Zhuo and Yi repaired roads—all said the alliance must be broken.
translations.idiomatic: The northern envoy long remained at Duting; several times he uttered insolent words; meanwhile Yun and Ying mobilized troops and Zhuo and Yi repaired roads—all said the alliance must be broken.

sentences.zh: 向曰：「彼欲疆議速成，故多張虛勢以撼我。

translations.literal: Xiang said: "They wish the border negotiations to conclude quickly, therefore they greatly display empty show to shake us."
translations.idiomatic: Xiang said, "They wish the border negotiations to conclude quickly, therefore they greatly display empty show to shake us."

sentences.zh: 使者懼不如其請，故肆嫚言以徼幸取成。

translations.literal: The envoy fears he will not get his request, therefore he speaks insolently to try by luck to force success.
translations.idiomatic: The envoy fears he will not get his request, therefore he speaks insolently to try by luck to force success.

sentences.zh: 兵來不除道，其亦無能為也已。

translations.literal: Troops come but do not clear the roads—they can do nothing after all."
translations.idiomatic: Troops come but do not clear the roads—they can do nothing after all."

sentences.zh: 」後皆如向言。

translations.literal: Afterward all was as Xiang said.
translations.idiomatic: Afterward all was as Xiang said.

sentences.zh: 遷工部侍郎。

translations.literal: He was transferred to Vice Minister of Works.
translations.idiomatic: He was transferred to Vice Minister of Works.

sentences.zh: 向控辭，賜詔弗允。

translations.literal: Xiang submitted a letter declining; an edict was granted refusing his request.
translations.idiomatic: Xiang submitted a letter declining; an edict was granted refusing his request.

sentences.zh: 故事，前兩府辭官乃降詔，兩省得詔自向始。

translations.literal: By precedent, only former chief ministers who declined office received edicts; receiving an edict while in the two Secretariats began with Xiang.
translations.idiomatic: By precedent, only former chief ministers who declined office received edicts; receiving an edict while in the two Secretariats began with Xiang.

sentences.zh: 元豐元年，召同知樞密院。

translations.literal: In the first year of Yuanfeng he was summoned as Associate Commissioner of the Bureau of Military Affairs.
translations.idiomatic: In the first year of Yuanfeng he was summoned as Associate Commissioner of the Bureau of Military Affairs.

sentences.zh: 向幹局絕人，尤善商財，計算無遺策，用心至到，然甚者不能無病民，所上課間失實。

translations.literal: Xiang's capacity for affairs surpassed others; he was especially skilled at commercial finance, his calculations leaving nothing out, his attention thorough—yet at the extreme he could not avoid harming the people, and revenue reports sometimes fell short of fact.
translations.idiomatic: Xiang's capacity for affairs surpassed others; he was especially skilled at commercial finance, his calculations leaving nothing out, his attention thorough—yet at the extreme he could not avoid harming the people, and revenue reports sometimes fell short of fact.

sentences.zh: 時方尚功利，王安石從中主之，御史數有言，不聽也。

translations.literal: The age then valued utility and profit; Wang Anshi supported him from within; censors repeatedly spoke out, but the emperor would not listen.
translations.idiomatic: The age then valued utility and profit; Wang Anshi supported him from within; censors repeatedly spoke out, but the emperor would not listen.

sentences.zh: 向以是益得展奮其材業，至於論兵帝所，通暢明決，遂由文俗吏得大用。

translations.literal: Because of this Xiang was able to deploy his talents all the more; when he discussed military matters at court his speech was fluent and clear, and thus from a routine civil official he rose to great employment.
translations.idiomatic: Because of this Xiang was able to deploy his talents all the more; when he discussed military matters at court his speech was fluent and clear, and thus from a routine civil official he rose to great employment.

sentences.zh: 及在政地，同列質以西北事，則養威持重，未嘗啟其端，非常所以屬望意。

translations.literal: Once in power, when colleagues questioned him on northwestern affairs, he nursed prestige and held steady, never opening the matter—quite unlike what had been expected of him.
translations.idiomatic: Once in power, when colleagues questioned him on northwestern affairs, he nursed prestige and held steady, never opening the matter—quite unlike what had been expected of him.

sentences.zh: 會詔民畜馬，向既奉命，旋知民不便，議欲改為。

translations.literal: When an edict ordered the people to raise horses, Xiang had just received the command when he soon learned the people found it inconvenient and debated changing it.
translations.idiomatic: When an edict ordered the people to raise horses, Xiang had just received the command when he soon learned the people found it inconvenient and debated changing it.

sentences.zh: 於是舒亶論向反覆無大臣體，斥知潁州。

translations.literal: Thereupon Shu Dan impeached Xiang for inconsistency unbecoming a great minister and had him removed as prefect of Yingzhou.
translations.idiomatic: Thereupon Shu Dan impeached Xiang for inconsistency unbecoming a great minister and had him removed as prefect of Yingzhou.

sentences.zh: 又改隨州，卒，年六十六。

translations.literal: He was again transferred to Suizhou and died, aged sixty-six.
translations.idiomatic: He was again transferred to Suizhou and died, at the age of sixty-six.

sentences.zh: 元祐中，錄其言，諡曰「恭敏」。

translations.literal: In Yuanyou his words were recorded and he was given the posthumous title "Gongmin."
translations.idiomatic: In Yuanyou his words were recorded and he was given the posthumous title Gongmin, "Respectful and Keen."

sentences.zh: 子紹彭，有翰墨名，中子嗣昌。

translations.literal: His son Shaopeng had a name in calligraphy; his second son was Sichang.
translations.idiomatic: His son Shaopeng had a name in calligraphy; his second son was Sichang.

sentences.zh: 子 嗣昌

translations.literal: Son: Sichang
translations.idiomatic: Son: Sichang

sentences.zh: 嗣昌亦以吏材奮。

translations.literal: Sichang also rose through administrative talent.
translations.idiomatic: Sichang also rose through administrative talent.

sentences.zh: 崇寧中，歷熙河轉運判官，梓州、陝西轉運副使，直龍圖閣、集賢殿修撰，入為左司郎中，擢徽猷閣待制、陝西都轉運使，知渭州，改慶州。

translations.literal: In Chongning he served successively as Xihe transportation judicial officer, vice transport commissioner of Zizhou and Shaanxi, direct associate of the Longtu Pavilion and compiler of the Hall of Assembled Worthies, entered as Left Department Director, was promoted to editorial acolyte of the Huiyou Pavilion and Shaanxi chief transport commissioner, made prefect of Weizhou, then transferred to Qingzhou.
translations.idiomatic: In Chongning he served successively as Xihe transportation judicial officer, vice transport commissioner of Zizhou and Shaanxi, direct associate of the Longtu Pavilion and compiler of the Hall of Assembled Worthies, entered as Left Department Director, was promoted to editorial acolyte of the Huiyou Pavilion and Shaanxi chief transport commissioner, made prefect of Weizhou, then transferred to Qingzhou.

sentences.zh: 監公使庫皇寘坐獄，嗣昌奏請之。

translations.literal: Supervisor of the Public Envoy Store Huang Zhi was imprisoned; Sichang memorialized requesting his release.
translations.idiomatic: Supervisor of the Public Envoy Store Huang Zhi was imprisoned; Sichang memorialized requesting his release.

sentences.zh: 遂以監臨自盜責安化軍節度副使，安置郢州。

translations.literal: He was therefore charged with supervising theft and demoted to Vice Military Commissioner of Anhua Army, settled at Yingzhou.
translations.idiomatic: He was therefore charged with supervising theft and demoted to Vice Military Commissioner of Anhua Army, settled at Yingzhou.

sentences.zh: 起知相州，復待制、知太原府。

translations.literal: He was restored as prefect of Xiangzhou, again made editorial acolyte, and prefect of Taiyuan.
translations.idiomatic: He was restored as prefect of Xiangzhou, again made editorial acolyte, and prefect of Taiyuan.

sentences.zh: 論築涇原三倉勞，加顯謨閣直學士；

translations.literal: For memorializing the labor of building three granaries in Jingyuan, he was made direct academician of the Hall of Xianmo;
translations.idiomatic: For memorializing the labor of building three granaries in Jingyuan, he was made direct academician of the Hall of Xianmo;

sentences.zh: 又以撫納西羌功，進延康、宣和殿學士，拜禮部、刑部尚書。

translations.literal: and for pacifying and winning over the western Qiang, he was promoted to academician of the Halls of Yankang and Xuanhe and appointed Vice Minister of Rites and Vice Minister of Justice.
translations.idiomatic: and for pacifying and winning over the western Qiang, he was promoted to academician of the Halls of Yankang and Xuanhe and appointed Vice Minister of Rites and Vice Minister of Justice.

sentences.zh: 坐啟擬反覆罷，提舉崇福宮。

translations.literal: He was removed for inconsistent nominations in memorials and made commissioner of the Chongfu Palace.
translations.idiomatic: He was removed for inconsistent nominations in memorials and made commissioner of the Chongfu Palace.

sentences.zh: 久之，遷延康殿學士、知延安府，賜第京師。

translations.literal: After long service he was transferred to academician of the Hall of Yankang and prefect of Yan'an, and granted a residence in the capital.
translations.idiomatic: After long service he was transferred to academician of the Hall of Yankang and prefect of Yan'an, and granted a residence in the capital.

sentences.zh: 當遷官，丐回授其子昶京秩。

translations.literal: When he was due for promotion he begged to transfer the benefit to his son Chang for a capital rank.
translations.idiomatic: When he was due for promotion he begged to transfer the benefit to his son Chang for a capital rank.

sentences.zh: 嗣昌前後因事六七貶，多以欺罔獲罪。

translations.literal: Sichang was demoted six or seven times for various matters, mostly convicted of deception.
translations.idiomatic: Sichang was demoted six or seven times for various matters, mostly convicted of deception.

sentences.zh: 至是，言者並論之，降為待制，卒。

translations.literal: At this critics joined in impeaching him; he was reduced to editorial acolyte and died.
translations.idiomatic: At this critics joined in impeaching him; he was reduced to editorial acolyte and died.

sentences.zh: 先是，徽宗有意圖北方，遣譚稹銜命訪諸帥，韓粹彥、洪中孚皆力云不可，嗣昌乃潤飾諜詞，以開邊隙。

translations.literal: Earlier Emperor Huizong had intended to move against the north and sent Tan Zai on mission to consult the commanders; Han Cuiyan and Hong Zhongfu both strongly said it could not be done, but Sichang embellished spy reports to open a border conflict.
translations.idiomatic: Earlier Emperor Huizong had intended to move against the north and sent Tan Zai on mission to consult the commanders; Han Cuiyan and Hong Zhongfu both strongly said it could not be done, but Sichang embellished spy reports to open a border conflict.

sentences.zh: 及論事帝前，語至興師，或感激流涕。

translations.literal: When he discussed matters before the emperor and speech turned to raising armies, he sometimes wept with emotion.
translations.idiomatic: When he discussed matters before the emperor and speech turned to raising armies, he sometimes wept with emotion.

sentences.zh: 造亂之咎，人皆歸責焉。

translations.literal: The blame for creating disorder was attributed to him by all.
translations.idiomatic: The blame for creating disorder was attributed to him by all.

sentences.zh: 章楶，字質夫，建州浦城人。

translations.literal: Zhang Jie, style name Zhifu, was a man of Pucheng in Jianzhou.
translations.idiomatic: Zhang Jie, courtesy name Zhifu, was a native of Pucheng in Jianzhou.

sentences.zh: 祖頻，為侍御史，忤章獻后旨黜官，仁宗欲用之而卒，楶以叔得象蔭，為孟州司戶參軍。

translations.literal: His grandfather Pin served as attendant censor; offending Empress Dowager Zhangxian he was dismissed; Emperor Renzong wished to employ him but he died before that; Jie received yin privilege through his uncle Dexiang and served as revenue officer of Mengzhou.
translations.idiomatic: His grandfather Pin served as attendant censor; offending Empress Dowager Zhangxian he was dismissed; Emperor Renzong wished to employ him but he died before that; Jie received yin privilege through his uncle Dexiang and served as revenue officer of Mengzhou.

sentences.zh: 應舉入京，聞父對獄於魏，棄不就試，馳往直其冤。

translations.literal: Going to the capital for the examinations, he heard his father was on trial in Wei; he abandoned the test and raced there to right the injustice.
translations.idiomatic: Going to the capital for the examinations, he heard his father was on trial in Wei; he abandoned the test and raced there to right the injustice.

sentences.zh: 還，試禮部第一，擢知陳留縣，歷提舉陝西常平、京東轉運判官、提點湖北刑獄、成都路轉運使，入為考功、吏部、右司員外郎。

translations.literal: Returning, he placed first in the Ministry of Rites examination, was promoted to prefect of Chenliu County, and served successively as Shaanxi Ever-Normal commissioner, Jingdong transportation judicial officer, Hubei judicial commissioner, and Chengdu circuit transport commissioner; he entered court as Director of Merit, Director of Personnel, and Right Department Vice Director.
translations.idiomatic: Returning, he placed first in the Ministry of Rites examination, was promoted to prefect of Chenliu County, and served successively as Shaanxi Ever-Normal commissioner, Jingdong transportation judicial officer, Hubei judicial commissioner, and Chengdu circuit transport commissioner; he entered court as Director of Merit, Director of Personnel, and Right Department Vice Director.

sentences.zh: 元祐初，以直龍圖閣知慶州。

translations.literal: At the start of Yuanyou he was made direct associate of the Longtu Pavilion and prefect of Qingzhou.
translations.idiomatic: At the start of Yuanyou he was made direct associate of the Longtu Pavilion and prefect of Qingzhou.

sentences.zh: 時朝廷戢兵，戒邊吏勿妄動，且捐葭蘆、安疆等四砦予夏，使歸其永樂之人。

translations.literal: The court then restrained military action, warned frontier officials not to act rashly, and ceded four stockades including Jialu and Anjiang to the Xia so they would return the people of Yongle.
translations.idiomatic: The court then restrained military action, warned frontier officials not to act rashly, and ceded four stockades including Jialu and Anjiang to the Xia so they would return the people of Yongle.

sentences.zh: 夏得砦益驕。

translations.literal: Gaining the stockades, the Xia grew all the more arrogant.
translations.idiomatic: Gaining the stockades, the Xia grew all the more arrogant.

sentences.zh: 楶言：「夏嗜利畏威，不有懲艾，邊不得休息，宜稍取其土疆，如古削地之制，以固吾圉。

translations.literal: Jie said: "The Xia crave profit and fear authority; without punishment and restraint the frontier cannot rest; we should take some of their territory, as in the ancient system of reducing land, to strengthen our borders."
translations.idiomatic: Jie said, "The Xia crave profit and fear authority; without punishment and restraint the frontier cannot rest; we should take some of their territory, as in the ancient system of reducing land, to strengthen our borders."

sentences.zh: 然後諸路出兵，據其要害，不一再舉，勢將自蹙矣。

translations.literal: Then the various circuits should send troops, hold their vital points, and with one or two campaigns their strength will constrict of itself."
translations.idiomatic: Then the various circuits should send troops, hold their vital points, and with one or two campaigns their strength will constrict of itself."

sentences.zh: 」遂乘便出討，以致其師，夏果入圍環州。

translations.literal: Thereupon he took advantage of an occasion to go on campaign and lure their army; the Xia indeed entered and besieged Huanzhou.
translations.idiomatic: Thereupon he took advantage of an occasion to go on campaign and lure their army; the Xia indeed entered and besieged Huanzhou.

sentences.zh: 楶先用間知之，遣驍將折可適伏兵洪德城。

translations.literal: Jie first learned through spies; he dispatched the brave general Zhe Keshi to ambush at Hongde city.
translations.idiomatic: Jie first learned through spies; he dispatched the brave general Zhe Keshi to ambush at Hongde city.

sentences.zh: 夏師過之，伏兵識其母梁氏旗幟，鼓噪而出，斬獲甚眾。

translations.literal: When the Xia army passed, the ambush recognized the banners of their mother Lady Liang, raised a clamor and sallied forth, and beheaded and captured many.
translations.idiomatic: When the Xia army passed, the ambush recognized the banners of their mother Lady Liang, raised a clamor and sallied forth, and beheaded and captured many.

sentences.zh: 又預毒於牛圈瀦水，夏人馬飲者多死。

translations.literal: He also poisoned beforehand the water in the cattle pens; many Xia horses died from drinking.
translations.idiomatic: He also poisoned beforehand the water in the cattle pens; many Xia horses died from drinking.

sentences.zh: 召權戶部侍郎。

translations.literal: He was summoned as acting Vice Minister of Revenue.
translations.idiomatic: He was summoned as acting Vice Minister of Revenue.

sentences.zh: 明年，除知同州。

translations.literal: The next year he was made prefect of Tongzhou.
translations.idiomatic: The next year he was made prefect of Tongzhou.

sentences.zh: 紹聖初，知應天府，加集賢殿修撰、知廣州，徙江、淮發運使。

translations.literal: At the start of Shaosheng he was made prefect of Yingtian Prefecture, added as compiler of the Hall of Assembled Worthies and prefect of Guangzhou, then transferred to Jiang-Huai transport commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: At the start of Shaosheng he was made prefect of Yingtian Prefecture, added as compiler of the Hall of Assembled Worthies and prefect of Guangzhou, then transferred to Jiang-Huai transport commissioner.

sentences.zh: 哲宗訪以邊事，對合旨，命知渭州。

translations.literal: Emperor Zhezong consulted him on frontier affairs; his replies suited the emperor's intent, and he was ordered to serve as prefect of Weizhou.
translations.idiomatic: Emperor Zhezong consulted him on frontier affairs; his replies suited the emperor's intent, and he was ordered to serve as prefect of Weizhou.

sentences.zh: 至即上言城胡蘆河川，據形勝以逼夏。

translations.literal: On arrival he immediately memorialized to fortify the Hulu River valley and seize strategic terrain to press the Xia.
translations.idiomatic: On arrival he immediately memorialized to fortify the Hulu River valley and seize strategic terrain to press the Xia.

sentences.zh: 乃以三月及熙河、秦風、環慶四路之師，陽繕理他堡壁數十所，自示其怯。

translations.literal: In the third month he gathered troops from the four circuits of Xihe, Qinfeng, Huanqing, and others, openly repaired several dozen other forts and walls, showing himself timid.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month he gathered troops from the four circuits of Xihe, Qinfeng, Huanqing, and others, openly repaired several dozen other forts and walls, showing himself timid.

sentences.zh: 或以楶怯，請曰：「此夏必爭之地，夏方營石門峽，去我三十里，能奪而有之乎？

translations.literal: Some, thinking Jie timid, asked: "This is ground the Xia must contest; the Xia are now fortifying Shimen Gorge thirty li from us—can we seize and hold it?"
translations.idiomatic: Some, thinking Jie timid, asked, "This is ground the Xia must contest; the Xia are now fortifying Shimen Gorge thirty li from us—can we seize and hold it?"

sentences.zh: 」楶又陽謝之，陰具板築守戰之備，帥四路師出胡蘆河川，築二城於石門峽江口好水河之陰。

translations.literal: Jie again openly declined, but secretly prepared construction and defense equipment; he led the four-circuit army out the Hulu River valley and built two cities on the north bank of the Haoshui River at the mouth of Shimen Gorge.
translations.idiomatic: Jie again openly declined, but secretly prepared construction and defense equipment; he led the four-circuit army out the Hulu River valley and built two cities on the north bank of the Haoshui River at the mouth of Shimen Gorge.

sentences.zh: 二旬有二日成，賜名平夏城、靈平砦。

translations.literal: In twenty-two days they were complete; they were named Pingxia city and Lingping Stockade.
translations.idiomatic: In twenty-two days they were complete; they were named Pingxia city and Lingping Stockade.

sentences.zh: 方興役時，夏以其眾來乘，楶迎擊敗之。

translations.literal: While construction was underway the Xia came with their forces to strike; Jie met them and defeated them.
translations.idiomatic: While construction was underway the Xia came with their forces to strike; Jie met them and defeated them.

sentences.zh: 既而環慶、鄜延、河東、熙河皆相繼築城，進拓其境，夏人愕視不敢動。

translations.literal: Soon Huanqing, Yanyan, Hedong, and Xihe all built cities in succession, extending their territory; the Xia stared in astonishment and did not dare move.
translations.idiomatic: Soon Huanqing, Yanyan, Hedong, and Xihe all built cities in succession, extending their territory; the Xia stared in astonishment and did not dare move.

sentences.zh: 夏主遂奉其母合將數十萬兵圍平夏，疾攻十餘日，建高車臨城，填塹而進，不能克，一夕遁去。

translations.literal: The Xia ruler then led his mother and combined forces of several hundred thousand to besiege Pingxia; they attacked fiercely for more than ten days, built high towers overlooking the city, filled the moat and advanced, but could not take it and fled in one night.
translations.idiomatic: The Xia ruler then led his mother and combined forces of several hundred thousand to besiege Pingxia; they attacked fiercely for more than ten days, built high towers overlooking the city, filled the moat and advanced, but could not take it and fled in one night.

sentences.zh: 夏統軍嵬名阿埋、西壽監軍妹勒都逋皆勇悍善戰，楶諜其弛備，遣折可適、郭成輕騎夜襲，直入其帳執之，盡俘其家，虜馘三千餘、牛羊十萬，夏主震駭。

translations.literal: Xia commanders Weiming Ami and Xishou supervisor Meledu were fierce and skilled in battle; Jie learned through spies that their guard was lax and sent Zhe Keshi and Guo Cheng with light cavalry on a night raid; they entered their tent directly and seized them, captured their entire families, took more than three thousand heads, and one hundred thousand cattle and sheep; the Xia ruler was greatly shaken.
translations.idiomatic: Xia commanders Weiming Ami and Xishou supervisor Meledu were fierce and skilled in battle; Jie learned through spies that their guard was lax and sent Zhe Keshi and Guo Cheng with light cavalry on a night raid; they entered their tent directly and seized them, captured their entire families, took more than three thousand heads, and one hundred thousand cattle and sheep; the Xia ruler was greatly shaken.

sentences.zh: 哲宗為御紫宸殿受賀，累擢楶樞密直學士、龍圖閣端明殿學士，進階大中大夫。

translations.literal: Emperor Zhezong held court in the Hall of Zichen to receive congratulations; Jie was repeatedly promoted to direct academician of the Bureau of Military Affairs and the Longtu and Duanming halls, and advanced in rank to Grand Master of the Court.
translations.idiomatic: Emperor Zhezong held court in the Hall of Zichen to receive congratulations; Jie was repeatedly promoted to direct academician of the Bureau of Military Affairs and the Longtu and Duanming halls, and advanced in rank to Grand Master of the Court.

sentences.zh: 楶在涇原四年，凡創州一、城砦九，薦拔偏裨，不間廝役，至於夏降人折可適、李忠傑、朱智用，咸受其馭。

translations.literal: Jie was in Jingyuan four years; in all he created one prefecture and nine forts and stockades, recommended subordinate officers without regard to rank, and even Xia submitters Zhe Keshi, Li Zhongjie, and Zhu Zhiyong all came under his command.
translations.idiomatic: Jie was in Jingyuan four years; in all he created one prefecture and nine forts and stockades, recommended subordinate officers without regard to rank, and even Xia submitters Zhe Keshi, Li Zhongjie, and Zhu Zhiyong all came under his command.

sentences.zh: 夏自平夏之敗，不復能軍，屢請命乞和，哲宗亦為之寢兵。

translations.literal: Since the defeat at Pingxia the Xia could no longer field armies; they repeatedly begged for orders and sued for peace, and Zhezong also ceased military action on their account.
translations.idiomatic: Since the defeat at Pingxia the Xia could no longer field armies; they repeatedly begged for orders and sued for peace, and Zhezong also ceased military action on their account.

sentences.zh: 楶立邊功，為西方最。

translations.literal: Jie established frontier merit unmatched in the west.
translations.idiomatic: Jie established frontier merit unmatched in the west.

sentences.zh: 時章惇用事，楶與惇同宗，其得興事，頗為世所疑。

translations.literal: At the time Zhang Dun held power; Jie was of the same clan as Dun, and that he was able to launch campaigns was much suspected by the world.
translations.idiomatic: At the time Zhang Dun held power; Jie was of the same clan as Dun, and that he was able to launch campaigns was much suspected by the world.

sentences.zh: 徽宗立，請老，徙知河南。

translations.literal: When Emperor Huizong acceded, Jie requested retirement and was transferred as prefect of Henan.
translations.idiomatic: When Emperor Huizong acceded, Jie requested retirement and was transferred as prefect of Henan.

sentences.zh: 入見，留拜同知樞密院事，俾其子縡為開封推官以便養。
